definitions.explanation: A large warship designed to serve as a mobile airbase, carrying and launching military aircraft. An abbreviation of {航空母艦|こうくうぼかん}.

examples.japanese: {空母|くうぼ}から{戦闘機|せんとうき}が{発進|はっしん}した。
examples.english: Fighter jets launched from the aircraft carrier.

examples.japanese: {空母|くうぼ}は{海軍|かいぐん}の{主力|しゅりょく}だ。
examples.english: Aircraft carriers are the mainstay of the navy.

examples.japanese: {新型|しんがた}の{空母|くうぼ}が{太平洋|たいへいよう}に{配備|はいび}されたというニュースが{流|なが}れた。
examples.english: News broke that a new aircraft carrier had been deployed to the Pacific.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of {航空母艦|こうくうぼかん} (aviation mother ship). The full form is still used in formal or historical contexts, but {空母|くうぼ} is the standard everyday term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原子力|げんしりょく}{空母|くうぼ} (nuclear aircraft carrier)
- {空母|くうぼ}{打撃群|だげきぐん} (carrier strike group)
- {空母|くうぼ}を{建造|けんぞう}する (to build an aircraft carrier)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {航空母艦|こうくうぼかん}: aircraft carrier (full, formal term)
- {護衛艦|ごえいかん}: escort ship, destroyer (Japan's Maritime Self-Defense Force term)
